name: Flicker Instant Charge (FIC)
summary: FIC Sayuri's {input:236A} before its projectile connects.
description: Cancel a projectile move during its brief built-in FIC window.

pages.title: Flicker Instant Charge
pages.text: Normally you IC after an attack hits or gets guarded. Some moves instead have a short, fixed window where you can IC BEFORE they connect - that is Flicker Instant Charge, or FIC. The input is always {input:22C}; {tone:red_ic|Red RF} gives Red FIC and {tone:blue_ic|Light Blue RF} gives Blue FIC.

pages.title: Use the Move's Window
pages.text: Sayuri's {input:236A} Magical Shot gets its FIC window once the projectile appears. Wait until the shot is clearly out, then hit {input:22C} while Sayuri is still recovering. The projectile keeps flying after the FIC - free cover to act behind.

tasks.label: FIC: {input:236A} > {input:22C} before the shot connects
tasks.prompt: Fire Magical Shot, then tap 22C during 236A's FIC window - while the projectile is still travelling.

feedback.success: Nice - Sayuri was free to move while Magical Shot was still travelling.
feedback.failure: Wait until you can SEE Magical Shot, then hit 22C during 236A's short FIC window - before the shot reaches Misaki.
